Two claims in the guide were wrong rather than merely stale and both were corrected. First, Broken: the guide said '10 still open ... nothing critical is currently open' while the screen says '13 open' and 'critical 1 open'. Source settles it - broken.ts:177 keeps a defect in the open list unless isUnresolved(status) is false, and defects.ts:441 defines that as status not in {verified, wont_fix}, so a defect marked `fixed` is still open. The guide now states the rule and stops telling Erik nothing critical is open. Second, /work-items/new: the guide carried 'UNVERIFIED: submitting the form' while spec/prod.md lines 818-825 record d4000f submitting it through the product and creating a row confirmed against the database. Neither error would have been caught by re-reading the guide; both needed the screen.
